trace.text: You alright, friend? This stove needs more tending before the next batch.
Look. The stove needs tending, not a lecture from you, Ana.
Um... the roster says there are 7 people cooking this morning, um...
Look. Seven people makes for seven servings, Tam, which is a reasonable amount.
Enough. Odo, the stew needs enough seasoning, enough seasoning.
Enough. A pinch of salt, friend, and the simmering will see itself.
You're burning the stew again, Dee.
He was a quiet scrap picker, friend, and we are sad to see him go.
Look. He spent less than ten percent of his time ever holding a decent meal.
He did manage to make some passable porridge, um... though.
Is the stew hot enough for everyone, friend?
It is warm enough, friend, for the meal.
Look. It is cooked to the established standard, less hot than the last ration.
The stew is palatable enough for 8 souls. We'll see about that being substantial.
Just warm enough? Maybe I'll add more herbs to the next batch, friend.
He went down fast, a sudden shot, and the noise stopped.
Hale did seem to tire too quickly, friend.
Hale was strong, even when the blow came.
We gather now for the ending. Enough. For the ending.
Dee, you're speaking at length, friend.
Look. The speech will take as long as it is worth.
Bram, is that stew ready for the mourners, friend?
Look. The stew costs five days of supply, Ana.
Bram, um... does the data suggest the rations will hold for the next twenty days?
Look. The stores cost nine more days, kid.
A table for this offering, then.
Um... the dining room's much better than this cramped kitchen, I guess.
Cy, how are you managing with all this cooking, friend?
Just another day at the hearth, we will see what the next meal brings.
This stew is good, but does anyone know where the extra firewood went, friend?
The wood went to keep the lamps lit last night.
The lamps needed it, Mara, keep the dark at bay.
The lamps burn hot, but the next meal better be plentiful, we'll see.
Maybe if we keep working, we can get more than just lamps lit, friend.
